<mxfile host="Electron" agent="fp-docs" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="fp-outbox-sequence" name="Transactional Outbox Sequence"> <mxGraphModel dx="1414" dy="841" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1720" pageHeight="1200" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="p1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#08427B;strokeColor=#06315C;fontColor=#ffffff;fontStyle=1;" value="Оркестратор саги
(финализация заказа)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="180" x="60" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#333333;fontStyle=1;" value="PostgreSQL ORDER
(notification_outbox)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="180" x="330" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontStyle=1;" value="OutboxPublisher
(@Scheduled, ORDERService)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="600" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;" value="RabbitMQ" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="180" x="890" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontStyle=1;" value="NOTIFICATIONService
(consumer)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="200" x="1150" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#333333;fontStyle=1;" value="PostgreSQL NOTIFICATION
(processed_messages)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="220" x="1430" y="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l1" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="150" y="100" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="150" y="1010" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l2" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="420" y="100" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="420" y="1010" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l3" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="100" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="700" y="1010" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l4" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="980" y="100" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="980" y="1010" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l5" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1250" y="100" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1250" y="1010" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l6" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1540" y="100" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1540" y="1010" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m1" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;fontSize=11;" value="1: NotificationEvent (eventId) + финализация заказа - ОДНА транзакция (обе ветки: PLACED и FAILED)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="150" y="150" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="420" y="150" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m2" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;fontSize=11;" value="2: @Scheduled-вычитка: SELECT ... WHERE status = NEW (publish-delay ~1с)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="230" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="420" y="230" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m3" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#438DD5;fontColor=#08427B;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="3: convertAndSend → notifications.events / notification.event
(mandatory=true, correlationId=eventId, publisher-confirm-type=correlated)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="300" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="980" y="300" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="alt" parent="1" style="shape=umlFrame;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;width=280;height=30;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontColor=#6c8ebf;fontStyle=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;" value="alt - результат доставки в брокер" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="320" width="660" x="380" y="330" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m4" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontColor=#2f5b20;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="ack (confirm)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="980" y="380" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="700" y="380" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m5" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontColor=#2f5b20;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="4a: status → SENT (sent_at)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="425" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="420" y="425" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="div1" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=10;fontColor=#666666;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;" value="nack | returned"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="390" y="465" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1030" y="465" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m6" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontColor=#7a620f;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="nack / returned (requeueByEventId)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="980" y="500" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="700" y="500" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m7" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontColor=#7a620f;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="4b: возврат в status = NEW - повторная публикация"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint as="offset" /> <mxPoint x="700" y="545" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="420" y="545" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="div2" edge="1" parent="1" style="endArrow=none;dashed=1;html=1;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=10;fontColor=#666666;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;" value="ошибка публикации"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="390" y="580" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1030" y="580" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m8" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#B85450;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="4c: attempts++; при attempts ≥ 5 → FAILED (ручное разбирательство)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="700" y="620" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="420" y="620" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m9" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="5: consume из notification.queue (concurrentConsumers=1)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="980" y="710" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1250" y="710" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m10" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#000000;fontSize=11;" value="6: дедупликация по eventId: маркер в processed_messages + уведомление одной транзакцией; повторная доставка = no-op"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1250" y="770" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1540" y="770" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m11" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#B85450;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="7: ядовитое сообщение: 3 ретрая с backoff → исчерпание"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="1340" y="840" /> <mxPoint x="1340" y="880" /> </Array> <mxPoint x="1250" y="840" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="1250" y="880" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m12" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#B85450;fontSize=11;strokeWidth=2;" value="→ notification.queue.dlq (DlqCountingRecoverer)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1250" y="930" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="980" y="930" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note1" parent="1" style="shape=note;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;size=15;fillColor=#FFF2CC;strokeColor=#d6b656;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;" value="Идентичный механизм - в AUTH (auth_outbox → users.events / user.created) и USER (user_outbox → user.sync.events / user.profile.sync).<br>Очистка: ежечасно удаляются только SENT старше 7 дней (ретеншен); NEW и FAILED не удаляются никогда.<br>Повторные публикации безопасны: потребитель дедуплицирует по eventId (processed_messages), eventId outbox = eventId события." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="1340" x="60" y="1040" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Идентичный механизм - в AUTH (auth_outbox → users.events / user.created) и USER (user_outbox → user.sync.events / user.profile.sync).
Очистка: ежечасно удаляются только SENT старше 7 дней (ретеншен); NEW и FAILED не удаляются никогда.
Повторные публикации безопасны: потребитель дедуплицирует по eventId (processed_messages), eventId outbox = eventId события.
